title: AudioCodes Ltd. Q2 2026 Earnings Call Summary
excerpt: Moby summary of AudioCodes Ltd.'s Q2 2026 earnings call
content_html:
Moby Intelligence

Tue, August 4, 2026 at 4:01 PM CDT 2 min read

Strategic Pivot to AI-Driven Software and Services

Our analysts just identified a stock with the potential to be the next Nvidia. Tell us how you invest and we'll show you why it's our #1 pick. Tap here.

  • Management is successfully repositioning the company from legacy hardware to an AI-driven cloud and edge software provider, with recurring revenue now a primary growth engine.

  • Performance was driven by the 'dual growth engines' of Live Managed Services and Voice AI, which reached a combined annual recurring revenue (ARR) of $84 million, a 20% year-over-year increase.

  • The Microsoft Teams business remains a core pillar, contributing 66% of total planned revenue and benefiting from a 73% surge in total contract value tied to Microsoft Teams activity.

  • Voice AI revenue grew over 50% year-over-year, supported by the emergence of 'agentic AI' where voice is becoming the preferred medium for human interaction with large language models.

  • The connectivity business (gateways and SBCs) has stabilized and continues to generate strong cash flow, acting as a foundational layer for higher-margin AI orchestration services.

  • Operational efficiency improved as services now represent approximately 55% of total revenues, shifting the mix toward higher-quality, predictable income streams.

2026 Outlook and AI Expansion Strategy

  • Management raised 2026 revenue guidance to a range of $251 million to $256 million, reflecting increased confidence in the Voice AI and Microsoft Teams pipelines.

  • The company is targeting $50 million in Voice AI revenue by the end of 2028, supported by plans to increase investments in conversational AI technology.

  • Sales cycles for Voice AI solutions have shortened significantly to approximately 6 months, down from a historical range of 12 to 24 months, indicating maturing market adoption.

  • Expansion plans for 'Meeting Insight' involve moving beyond the current 2-3 core countries into substantially more global markets to scale monthly recurring revenue.

  • A major $10 million plus connectivity win is moving into production, expected to add $3 million to $4 million in annual revenue over the next three years.

One stock. Nvidia-level potential. 30M+ investors trust Moby to find it first. Get the pick. Tap here.

Capital Allocation and Market Risks

  • The company received Israeli court approval to repurchase up to $25 million in shares or declare dividends through November 2026, signaling confidence in cash flow sustainability.

  • A cash dividend of $0.20 per share was declared, totaling approximately $4.8 million to be paid in September 2026.

  • Management highlighted geopolitical risks, noting that current or future hostilities involving Israel could potentially disrupt operations or personnel availability.

  • The 'MIA Edge' solution was launched to address specific risks and regulatory requirements for 'air-gapped' or off-cloud AI deployments in government and defense sectors.
